title: ItInformationExchange
description: IT ontology composite — materialization of the ontology.json axes for TogafInformationExchange. Typing: extends TogafInformationExchange (chain converges to its GSM base). Facets are mounted as optional named properties keyed by lowerCamelCase of the facet's globally-unique title (the catalogue's facet mount rule — collision-free instance-level namespacing; JSON Schema does not namespace instance properties). Mounted axes — attributed-to: ProvAttribution; measured-by-data-quality: Iso25000DataAccessibility, Iso25000DataAccuracy, Iso25000DataAvailability, Iso25000DataCompleteness, Iso25000DataCompliance, Iso25000DataConfidentiality, Iso25000DataConsistency, Iso25000DataCredibility, Iso25000DataCurrentness, Iso25000DataEfficiency, Iso25000DataPortability, Iso25000DataPrecision, Iso25000DataRecoverability, Iso25000DataTraceability, Iso25000DataUnderstandability; measured-by-service-quality: Iso25000ServiceAdaptability, Iso25000ServiceMaintainability, Iso25000ServiceReliability, Iso25000ServiceResponsiveness, Iso25000ServiceSecurity, Iso25000ServiceSuitability, Iso25000ServiceTangibility, Iso25000ServiceUsability. Source: frameworks/it/ontology.json (static materialization; generator planned).
